title: Ball growth at all scales in universal covers of short metric graphs
summary: Let $Γ$ be a connected metric graph of first Betti number $b\ge 2$, and let $Γ_b$ be a trivalent graph of the same Betti number with all edges of unit length. We show that if $\text{length}(Γ) \le λ\, \text{length}(Γ_b)$, then the universal cover of $Γ$ contains a vertex around which, \emph{at every radius} $R\ge 0$, the ball is at least as long as the ball of radius $R$ in the trivalent tree whose edges all have length $3λ$.
